entry_points.summary: Validates INTENT.md frontmatter (6 required fields: artifact/slug/level/generated_at/frozen_at/planning_mode) and required sections per level. Returns ValidationResult(valid, errors).
Lints acceptance checklist items for non-observable criteria (bare 'runs'/'works' with no concrete object). Returns list[LintFailure(line_number, text)].
Stamps frozen_at with current UTC ISO in INTENT.md frontmatter. Idempotent: prints ALREADY_FROZEN:<iso> if already frozen. Called by /z-execute Step 1.
Sets frozen_at back to 'pending' in INTENT.md frontmatter. Idempotent (prints ALREADY_PENDING if already pending). Called by /z-amend Phase 6 to re-open a frozen contract for amendment.
Creates LEDGER.md with frontmatter (artifact, slug, intent_frozen_at) if absent. Idempotent: prints EXISTS: if file already present. Called by /z-execute Step 1.

Per-criterion acceptance evaluation from INTENT checklist + LEDGER citations + optional cumulative diff. Returns AcceptanceResult(criteria, verdict='done'|'continue'). Called at every BFS level checkpoint. Conservative: unknown==unmet.
Authoritative SPEC-vs-INTENT branch: SPEC.md present → IMPLEMENT_MODE=legacy (untouched); INTENT.md present → IMPLEMENT_MODE=intent. Neither → error. This is the ONLY detection seam (Invariant 4).
INTENT engine Step 1: freeze INTENT.md (idempotent), snapshot to archive/$RUN/INTENT.frozen.md on first freeze only, bootstrap LEDGER.md if absent. Inside if [[ IMPLEMENT_MODE == intent ]] block.

BFS while-loop: level-cap check → budget guard → dispatch task-tree-generator → execute level via reused per-task loop ($INTENT_MODE_CTX injected) → T011-LEDGER-HOOK flush → done_set_hash checkpoint (.bfs_level_state) → evaluate-acceptance → increment CURRENT_LEVEL or set BFS_DONE=1.

Reads workflow.planning_mode + workflow.intent_level. CLI flags --quick/--standard/--deep/--full override config. planning_mode=full → legacy SDD. planning_mode=intent → intent-classifier dispatch (or forced/flag level), level announce + user override gate, write INTENT.md.
Invariant 4 guard in /z-plan: if slug dir already has SPEC.md, force PLANNING_MODE=full regardless of config. Never overwrite a legacy plan with INTENT.md.

Haiku subagent. Input: task prompt + repo signals + optional forced_level. Output: LEVEL: quick|standard|deep + REASON: + SIGNALS:. Advisory — orchestrator announces pick, user may override. Fallback to 'standard' on error/empty.

Sonnet subagent. Input: frozen INTENT snapshot, LEDGER, level, unmet_criteria JSON, prior_level_outcomes, tasks_output_path, level_cap, budget_tokens_remaining, task_id_start. Output: writes TASKS.md batch for this level only — all siblings independent (Depends on: — always). Emits termination batch when level_cap or budget floor reached.

invariants: INV-1: INTENT.md is immutable after frozen_at is stamped. Edits require explicit reopen-intent (scripts/intent-schema.py:377).
INV-2: A level's TASKS.md is immutable while that level executes. done_set_hash checkpoint persisted to $ARCHIVE_DIR/.bfs_level_state at every level boundary (skills/z-execute/SKILL.md:903).
INV-3: LEDGER.md is append-only; never rewritten. bootstrap-ledger (line 494) is idempotent create-only; per-level content accumulates in ledger-level-N.pending and is flushed via T011-LEDGER-HOOK.

INV-4: Legacy SPEC/PLAN/TASKS plans detected by SPEC.md presence run on the unchanged legacy path — zero regression. Detection seam at skills/z-execute/SKILL.md:413 is the ONLY branch; do not add a second detection elsewhere.
INV-5: No new env vars. All new knobs (planning_mode, intent_level, intent_parallel_levels, hermes_enabled) are file-resolvable via config.py get workflow.<key> from .z-harness/config.toml.
INV-6: Old Hermes machinery (workstream gen, N=2 cross-cluster dispatch, write-handoff, scope-extractor) never executes unless workflow.hermes_enabled=true (default false).
gotchas: MODE DETECTION IS BINARY: SPEC.md presence = legacy (forever). Adding INTENT.md to a slug that already has SPEC.md does NOT switch it to INTENT mode. The legacy path wins.
frozen_at: 'pending' is a signal, not an error. /z-execute reads 'pending' as 'not yet frozen' and stamps the ISO on first execution. Do not delete the field.

stale_reason: amended-intent in TASKS.md frontmatter signals the task-tree-generator to regenerate rather than resume on the next /z-execute. Set by /z-amend Phase 6; consumed by the BFS loop generator dispatch.
evaluate-acceptance is called at EVERY level checkpoint, not just the last. It may return 'done' at Level 0 if the first level's tasks fully satisfy all criteria — the loop exits early.
intent_parallel_levels=false (default): independent same-level siblings run sequentially. Enabling it (true) requires workflow.hermes_enabled=true to have any effect — the two knobs are coupled.
Level state file is $ARCHIVE_DIR/.bfs_level_state (NOT .intent_level_state). Stores '<level> <done_set_hash>'. Hash mismatch on resume forces restart from level 0 — a safety fallback, not an error.

LEDGER content accumulates in $ARCHIVE_DIR/ledger-level-N.pending during per-level execute and is flushed atomically to LEDGER.md by the T011-LEDGER-HOOK at level end. Pending file is deleted after flush to prevent double-append on crash+resume.
workflow.intent_bfs_level_cap is read via config.py get but is NOT in DEFAULTS — resolves to None/empty. Orchestrator falls back to hardcoded 6. Set it explicitly in config.toml to override.
evaluate-acceptance scores 'unknown' as unmet (conservative bias). LEDGER citation without a non-empty cumulative diff (from INTENT_FROZEN_AT_COMMIT to HEAD) returns unknown, not met.
/z-do is a deprecated shim — it prints a notice and immediately hands off to /z-plan --quick. Its old body is removed.
/z-plan accepts --quick, --standard, --deep, --full CLI flags. Level flags set PLANNING_MODE=intent + forced level; --full sets PLANNING_MODE=full. All still fire the level announce+override gate.

config_keys.source: scripts/config.py DEFAULTS['workflow'] lines 78-86; intent_bfs_level_cap is NOT in DEFAULTS (runtime fallback to 6)

knobs.description: Default planner paradigm. 'full' = legacy SDD (SPEC/PLAN/TASKS). 'intent' = Adaptive INTENT (default).
Forced planning depth level, or 'auto' to let the intent-classifier choose.
Execute independent same-level tasks in parallel. Gated-off by default. Requires hermes_enabled=true to have effect.
Master gate for all old Hermes parallelism machinery. Default false = all workstream/handoff/cross-plan calls are no-ops.
Max BFS levels before halting. NOT in DEFAULTS — read via config.py get; absent resolves to 6. 0 = no cap (use with caution).
